title: temp profile isn't reset after given time period
body:
I know this doesn't seem to affect the latest version AAPS 3.4.2.6, but I've noticed the following issue with version 3.4.2.4: the temporary profile isn't reset after the specified time has elapsed; instead, it just keeps running indefinitely.

Also: it would be really great if the release notes were a little more verbose

comments.body: this has been already improved in v4
